# What CI runs. scripts/ci_plan/plan-ci.ts turns this into the typescript workflow's
# matrices; the documentation gates and the argv budget test read it too.
#
# One entry per line: a kind, then a value. Releases run oldest first.
#
#   supported    a released tmux in the support table. Pushes, pull requests,
#                and releases run the first and the last; scope=full runs all.
#   preview      a branch that becomes a release. It has no tag yet, so it
#                runs under scope=full and is not in the support claim.
#   development  unreleased tmux. It runs under scope=full and may fail.
#   bun          a Bun version the gates job runs
#   lane-bun     the Bun version the tmux lanes run, one of the above

supported 3.3a

supported 3.5a

supported 3.6a
supported 3.6b

supported 3.7a

development master
